title: Bún Chả
description: A classic Vietnamese dish featuring grilled pork patties served with steamed rice noodles and herbs.

ingredients.name: Fresh herbs
ingredients.notes: such as mint, basil, or cilantro

instructions: 1. In a medium bowl, mix the ground pork with minced garlic and grated ginger.
2. Divide the pork mixture into 4-6 portions, depending on the size of patty you prefer.
3. Shape each portion into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a patty.
4. Heat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat.
5. Cook the patties for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through.
6. While the patties are cooking, prepare the dipping sauce by mixing fish sauce, lime juice, and rice vinegar in a small bowl.
7. Cook the bun noodles according to the package instructions.
8. To assemble the dish, place a cooked patty on a bed of noodles, and garnish with fresh herbs and chili slices.
9. Serve immediately with the dipping sauce on the side.
